def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    path = "data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Report_Count.csv"
    # File has a title row above the true header; read with skiprows=1.
    df = pd.read_csv(path, skiprows=1, dtype=str)

    # Sometimes the header row is still present as the first data row (e.g., 'Year', '# of Reports').
    # Standardize column names.
    df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
    if df.shape[1] >= 2:
        df = df.rename(columns={df.columns[0]: "Year", df.columns[1]: "Reports"})
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unexpected column count: {df.shape[1]}")

    # Drop non-year footer/header rows; keep 4-digit years.
    df["Year"] = df["Year"].astype(str).str.strip()
    df = df[df["Year"].str.fullmatch(r"\d{4}", na=False)].copy()

    # Clean thousands separators and cast.
    df["Reports"] = (
        df["Reports"].astype(str).str.replace(",", "", regex=False).str.strip()
    )
    df["Reports"] = pd.to_numeric(df["Reports"], errors="coerce")
    df["Year"] = pd.to_numeric(df["Year"], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")
    df = df.dropna(subset=["Year", "Reports"]).copy()

    df = df.sort_values("Year").reset_index(drop=True)
    return df[["Year", "Reports"]]

def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    path = "data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Report_Count.csv"
    # File appears to have a title row above the true header; read with skiprows=1.
    df = pd.read_csv(path, skiprows=1, dtype=str)
    df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.columns]

    # Keep only the first two columns: Year and total Reports (Fraud + Identity Theft + Other)
    first_two = list(df.columns[:2])
    df = df[first_two].rename(columns={first_two[0]: "Year", first_two[1]: "Reports"})

    # Drop any repeated header rows that might appear in the body
    df = df[df["Year"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() != "year"].copy()

    # Extract a 4-digit year; non-year rows become NaN and will be dropped
    df["Year"] = df["Year"].astype(str).str.extract(r"(\d{4})", expand=False)

    # Clean reports counts and convert
    df["Reports"] = df["Reports"].astype(str).str.replace(",", "", regex=False).str.strip()
    df["Reports"] = pd.to_numeric(df["Reports"], errors="coerce")

    df = df.dropna(subset=["Year", "Reports"]).copy()

    # Keep year as string to satisfy the runtime's expected schema
    df["Year"] = df["Year"].astype(str)

    df = df.sort_values("Year").reset_index(drop=True)
    return df[["Year", "Reports"]]

def process(reportCount) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = reportCount.copy()
    df['Year'] = df['Year'].astype(int)
    df = df.sort_values('Year')

    # Compute year-over-year relative increase: (curr - prev) / prev
    df['prevReports'] = df['Reports'].shift(1)
    df['relIncrease'] = (df['Reports'] - df['prevReports']) / df['prevReports']

    # Restrict to 2002-2024 inclusive (YoY defined for 2002 based on 2001)
    df2 = df[(df['Year'] >= 2002) & (df['Year'] <= 2024) & df['prevReports'].notna()].copy()

    # Find the year with the maximum relative increase
    best = df2.loc[df2['relIncrease'].idxmax(), ['Year', 'relIncrease', 'Reports', 'prevReports']]
    return pd.DataFrame([best.to_dict()])
